solution.text:
Resultant of V→1,V→2,V→3 is V→1+V→2+V→3=λi^
⇒2sin⁡θ+2cos⁡θi^+2cos⁡θ-2sin⁡θj^+a+b+c-12k^=λi^
On comparison, we get, 
2sin⁡θ+2cos⁡θ=λ
2cos⁡θ-2sin⁡θ=0⇒tan⁡θ=1⇒ number of values of θ in -π,π is 2
Also, a+b+c=12⇒ number of solutions =11C2=55
Hence, number of quadruplets =55×2=110
